title: Case heap after PR 91/92 and thermal time slider (PR 93) in real Chrome

environment.base: worktree p-d merged with origin/main including PRs 91, 92 and 93
environment.browser: real Chrome (Claude in Chrome), own tab, vite dev on 127.0.0.1:5174, stdio connector with file-IPC driver; Chrome auto-translation to Japanese was active on the ?lang=en page (some dynamic text appears translated)
environment.load: About 13 GB free RAM earlier in the session, no heavy local processes started by me, other agents idle; machine load not otherwise measured. The first mesh/solve after starting vite was cold and exceeded 120 s once; later runs were fast.
environment.heapMethod: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize read twice 3 s apart at checkpoints (the script paused at each checkpoint). Garbage is not forced out: the first read right after a step can be much higher than the settled one (for example 390 -> 152 MB), so the settled value is reported.

run2_usedHeapMB_settled_onSamePageAfterR.note: run 2 started with run 1's heap still in the page, so its baseline is higher; transient peaks right after steps reached 1147 and 767 MB before GC

A_heap.roundTrip: archive revision and all 4 case revisions equal in both runs (archive sha256:389cdccf...), hash of the exported archive matches the declared one, 518 chunks
A_heap.renderer: no reload (timeOrigin unchanged) and no window error / unhandledrejection events recorded

budget.detail: CASE_MEMORY_BUDGET (256 MiB retained serialized bytes) could not be exceeded through the UI. At 1.0 mm a case is about 8.5 MB; the finest mesh that generates is 0.9 mm (0.8 mm and below report 'Element limit exceeded'). A thermal transient case at 0.9 mm with 61 snapshots is 9.4 MB each; 8 such cases archive to 75.2 MB (saves took 0.93-1.64 s). The 8-case cap triggers first: the 9th save is refused in 0.49 s with 'Maximum 8 cases' and the store stays intact (same 8 case revisions and archive revision after the refusal, export still works at 75,178,655 bytes). The budget message itself was not seen.

restoreAndCompare.restoreButton: passed: 'View saved result' (case list) shows the stored thermal result including the time panel; 'Duplicate and restore' restores inputs (transient heat, 40 steps, 21 snapshots) and clears the result as designed; the 8th case view also worked
restoreAndCompare.comparePanel: passed: heavy thermal case 1 vs case 4 of 8 compared, 'Comparison shown.', main viewer state identical before and after; the compare canvas now shows a colour gradient bar with 20 degC / 100 degC end labels, shared colour range text and 'Physical time: no time axis' (snapshots not used by compare)

B_thermalSlider.setup: thermal-demo, #transient-heat on, 2 s x 40 steps, #thermal-snapshots 21 (control range 0..61, label says 0 = do not store, 2-61, transient only), mesh 4 mm

checks.detail: #acoustic-time-frame 0..20 (21 frames), value 20 = final at 80 s / step 40; frame k shows time 4k s / step 2k
#acoustic-time-fine 0..1000; value 275 gives 22 s with 'Interpolated: linear display blend between stored frames...' ; 0 and 1000 are the first and final frames with no interpolation text
Play -> Pause while running, ran to the final frame (fine 1000, 80 s) and the button returned to Play; stored-frame slider change stops playback
probe at (5,5,20) = 40.967109648913144 C and (5,5,40) = 99.99999999999996 C with snapshots 21 and with snapshots unset (0): bit-identical; legend 20.00 -> 100.0 C
legend stays 20.00 -> 100.0 C at frames 0, 1, 5, 10, 19, 20 and at interpolated times; panel text says the colour range is fixed over all stored frames
with #thermal-snapshots 0 the panel is empty (no sliders), frameCount 0 and the result equals the final step

NOT refused: with frame 7 (28 s) displayed, probe returned final-step values (display.frameIndex null, T 40.967 / 100.0) with no error or warning. The panel text says flux, probes and export use the final step, so this follows the documented behaviour but may mislead

png still: accepted (final step by the panel text). webm with animation time: accepted. png-sequence animation time: refused with 'Time playback requires transient acoustic frames.' (message mentions acoustic only). exportCapabilities.timeSelection still says 'stored-acoustic-frames-only'
setResultView {deformScale:1} at frame 7 left the page on frame 7 / 28 s / same legend; the API's state.frameIndex stays null for thermal results (the stored frame is not exposed there)

caseSave of the 21-snapshot result (kind thermal); after loading another result, 'View saved result' restored the thermal result with frames 0..20, 80 s/step 40, slider and interpolation working; 'Duplicate and restore' restored transient-heat, 40 steps and snapshots 21
after restoring the thermal case the model name shown was the axial bar's name rather than the heat conduction sample's (cosmetic, not isolated)
no window errors or unhandled rejections recorded

notVerified: The CASE_MEMORY_BUDGET error path and its message (not reachable with available demos; 256 MiB of retained data was not approached)
Peak heap between checkpoints and the exact retained size (garbage not forced)
Visual correctness of thermal interpolation beyond the legend and one screenshot
Thermal compare at a shared time (compare ignores snapshots)
Japanese-language text of the new controls (Chrome translation interfered)
Clean foreground-tab timings (tab not the selected tab)
